subject: [RFC PATCH 11/18] mm/filemap: set PG_rcu_free on the folios that reads keep coming back to

2026-10-19.patch_summary: This patch introduces a new flag, PG_rcu_free, which is set on folios that are frequently accessed by readers. The flag delays the free of these folios' memory for a grace period after they are freed, allowing readers to access them without holding a reference. This trade-off is only made for hot folios, and not for streaming reads or truncated files that are not frequently accessed. The patch also introduces a new field in /proc/vmstat to count the number of pages marked with this flag.
